title: Public Law 119-47: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States…
summary: S.J.Res. 80, "A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to "National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska Integrated Activity Plan Record of Decision".", originated in the Senate of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-47 on 2025-12-05, according to Congress.gov.
